simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נָקִיק (H5357) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: נָקִיק (nâqîyq) means a cleft First listed occurrence: Isa 7 19.

definitions.full: H5357. naqiq [ נָקִיק ] noun masculine cleft of rock ; — only construct: singular הַסָּ֑לַע נְקִיק Jer 13:4 ; plural הַסְּלָעִים נְקִיקֵי Isa 7:19 (|| הַבַּתּוֺת נַחֲלֵי ), Jer 16:16 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to bore ;
